title: Payment Instrument
description: Fields shared by payment instruments in Checkout and Order. Payment handlers add instrument-specific credential and display fields, while each capability adds the fields it needs for routing, selection, or reporting.

id.description: Unique identifier for this instrument, assigned by the participant that introduces it. Identifiers assigned by another participant MUST be treated as opaque.

type.description: The broad category of the instrument (e.g., 'card', 'tokenized_card'). Specific schemas will constrain this to a constant value.

billing_address.description: The billing address associated with this payment method.

credential.description: Credential used to execute payment. This field is request-only and MUST NOT be returned in responses.

display.description: Display information for this payment instrument. Each payment instrument schema defines its specific display properties, as outlined by the payment handler.

selected_payment_instrument.title: Selected Payment Instrument
selected_payment_instrument.description: A Checkout payment instrument with handler routing and selection state.

handler_id.description: The unique identifier for the handler instance that produced this instrument. This corresponds to the `id` field in the Payment Handler definition.

selected.description: Whether this instrument is selected by the user.

order_payment_instrument.title: Order Payment Instrument
order_payment_instrument.description: Payment instrument as returned on an Order, which may include current authorization and total captured amounts.

authorized_amount.description: Amount currently authorized for this instrument, in the Order currency's minor units. Released and expired authorizations are excluded. Remaining capture capacity is a separate concept.

captured_amount.description: Total amount successfully captured or collected for this instrument, in the Order currency's minor units, before refunds, credits, disputes, or capture reversals. This measures capture rather than settlement or payout.
